verdict.rationale: Email aliases and masked addresses are a fair capability to ask of an email service like Outlook, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions creating aliases or masked addresses. Delegated send-on-behalf, Inbox rules and forwarding are adjacent features that do not hide the user's real address from sign-ups or strangers.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can use aliases or masked addresses so sign-ups and strangers never learn my real address
